metadata.question: Did the water in Lake Bosumtwi appear more green in December 2024 than in December 2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Lake Bosumtwi, Ghana (approx. 6.51°N, 1.41°W, 8-km-wide crater lake) - Collections: Sentinel-2 MSI (10 m) – highest chance of clear scenes - Date windows: 1–31 December 2015 and 1–31 December 2024 2. Masking strategy: - Apply Sentinel-2 cloud mask (QA60 + SCL) to keep only water pixels - Build a lake polygon to avoid surrounding forest pixels that bias greenness 3. Greenness proxy: - Chlorophyll-sensitive NDCI = (B5 – B4)/(B5 + B4) → Sentinel-2 B4 (665 nm), B5 (705 nm) - Mean NDCI per scene; higher NDCI ⇒ more phytoplankton ⇒ “greener” water 4. Safety checks: - If either month yields 0 images after filtering → C1 - Composite the available scenes per month (median) and count valid water pixels; if 0 remain → C2 - If both composites succeed, compare 2024 vs 2015 NDCI: – 2024 NDCI clearly higher → A (Yes) – 2024 NDCI ≤ 2015 NDCI → B (No) – Any null/NaN → C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Lake Bosumtwi rough outline (kept small to stay within quota) lake = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-1.43, 6.50], [-1.39, 6.50], [-1.39, 6.52], [-1.43, 6.52], [-1.43, 6.50] ]]) def get_comp(year): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(lake) .filterDate(f'{year}-12-01', f'{year}-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50))) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 comp = col.map(lambda img: img.addBands( img.select('B5').subtract(img.select('B4')) .divide(img.select('B5').add(img.select('B4'))) .rename('NDCI') .updateMask(img.select('QA60').eq(0)) .updateMask(img.select('SCL').eq(6)) # water )).median().clip(lake) cnt = comp.select('NDCI').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=lake, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NDCI').getInfo() if cnt is None or cnt == 0: return None, 0 val = comp.select('NDCI').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=lake, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NDCI').getInfo() return val, int(cnt) ndci15, pix15 = get_comp(2015) ndci24, pix24 = get_comp(2024) print(f"2015 NDCI: {ndci15:.3f} Pixels: {pix15}") print(f"2024 NDCI: {ndci24:.3f} Pixels: {pix24}") if ndci15 is None or ndci24 is None: print("C1") elif pix15 == 0 or pix24 == 0: print("C2") elif ndci24 > ndci15: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Lake Bosumtwi rough outline (kept small to stay within quota)
lake = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-1.43, 6.50], [-1.39, 6.50], [-1.39, 6.52],
    [-1.43, 6.52], [-1.43, 6.50]
]])

def get_comp(year):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
           .filterBounds(lake)
           .filterDate(f'{year}-12-01', f'{year}-12-31')
           .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    comp = col.map(lambda img: img.addBands(
        img.select('B5').subtract(img.select('B4'))
           .divide(img.select('B5').add(img.select('B4')))
           .rename('NDCI')
           .updateMask(img.select('QA60').eq(0))
           .updateMask(img.select('SCL').eq(6))  # water
       )).median().clip(lake)
    cnt = comp.select('NDCI').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=lake, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDCI').getInfo()
    if cnt is None or cnt == 0:
        return None, 0
    val = comp.select('NDCI').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=lake, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDCI').getInfo()
    return val, int(cnt)

ndci15, pix15 = get_comp(2015)
ndci24, pix24 = get_comp(2024)

print(f"2015 NDCI: {ndci15:.3f}  Pixels: {pix15}")
print(f"2024 NDCI: {ndci24:.3f}  Pixels: {pix24}")

if ndci15 is None or ndci24 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif pix15 == 0 or pix24 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif ndci24 > ndci15:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
